d:
Ash grey, short, messy hair with jagged bangs. Pale amber eyes with a vacant, haunting expression. Appears as a mature adult with a gaunt, hollowed face. Slender, wiry build wearing a tattered, charcoal grey and deep violet hooded robe with a high collar. Features a distinctive metallic mask covering the lower half of the face and several small, rusted needles embedded in the skin.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
